skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply regression models including Ordinary Least Squares (OLS)
Perform statistical inference and forecasting using econometric models
Handle qualitative variables within regression analysis
Select appropriate econometric models based on data characteristics
Analyze time series data and apply regression techniques to time series
Utilize advanced estimation methods such as Generalized Least Squares (GLS), robust standard errors, and instrumental variables
Use R/Python software for data processing and model analysis
